notes: Loop/median step. Original iterates the numbers 1..10 with a SQLite RECURSIVE CTE and takes their median as an ODBC passthrough query (WORKX.MEDIAN_VALUE = 5.5). Kept the same 1..10 sequence but generated it in a native DATA-step DO loop and took the median with PROC MEANS, so the demo runs without ODBC/SQLite. Output reproduces the documented median 5.5.
